games.name: The Trials [PHASE 0]
games.desc:
Welcome, Participant! 
Compete against other participants in a lethal facility designed to kill all but one. It's your choice to decide whether or not to participate, but once you do, the choice is no longer yours. The Trials is a thrilling adventure game that requires some wit and skill to succeed. 

I made The Trials (BETA) in 2019 and have decided to bring it back for a full series! The beta was child's play, Phase 1 is only the beginning. Join the group to stay in the loop with updates! 

**WANT TO BECOME A VALID PARTICIPANT?** 
~Join ZELZ to get the Valid Participant name tag! Ranks will have more relevance to the game in the future features~

games.name: Egg Hunt 2022: Lost in Time
games.desc:
Welcome to your grand journey, great eggventurer! Upon finding a mysterious crystal in a cavern, you unknowingly unleash a great evil that threatens not only the jungle, but the entire timeline. Will you be able to take on the challenges ahead in order to conquer your journey victoriously?

Take on the pesky rabbit Hopper as you traverse through the jungle; helping the residents, peculiar animals, and locating every last egg to power an advanced device & take back the timeline from chaotic madness!

This passionate project would not have been achieved without the creative inspiration from Egg Hunt 2018: The Great Yolktales, developed by the talented Fifteam.

This is a community-developed unofficial Egg Hunt experience, all egg rewards are in-experience ONLY and will NOT be reflected in your Inventory. We appreciate your understanding. Happy hunting! 🐇


Animation - DeepAquaticBlue
Scripting - DeepAquaticBlue & Programmables
Game Producer - DeepAquaticBlue & InnovationTime

games.name: The Zombie's Revenge v26.4.1
games.desc:
We're working with Roblox to undo the 16+ Age limit.

The Rogothian Empire stands on the edge of collapse. The Deluge has begun. Cities drown, enemies gather, and only those willing to rise from nothing will carve their place in history.

The hubris of the Dedsfang Dominion has gone unpunished for much too long. 
This war will decide everything.
And when it ends… perhaps there will finally be peace.

•⚔️Earn every weapon, every piece of armor, every upgrade, nothing is handed to you. You must prove your worth to the Empire, through badges and story completions.
•📜Fight through the Deluge campaign, face off an army by yourself or hold the line alongside your comrades.
•🦿Push beyond human limits with experimental cybernetic augmentations never meant for the average soldier.. Become powerful enough to claim the mettle of a legendary HERO yourself!!

🏅The Empire rewards those who endure:

+50% XP & Tokens on weekends
Premium: -5% XP Requirement.
